items.label: Yoke Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Precursor R&D projects in 2025: high-purity metal precursors for advanced nodes

set.signal: Precursor R&D projects in 2025: high-purity metal precursors for advanced nodes (expected to cover Cu, Co and Ru precursors and complete the ALD precursor line) concluded in December 2025; a new-generation high-k lanthanum precursor project and a spin-on dielectric (SOD) project also concluded in December 2025; solid-precursor pretreatment and a dedicated vaporisation-evaluation rig (2 sets) are in development; an area-selective deposition (ASD) evaluation system was completed. Packaging photoresists: RDL photoresist for wafer-level packaging is progressing normally and being promoted to customers, and a high-resolution RDL chemically amplified resist for IDMs is in technology development; both target customer R&D qualification.

items.reason: The R&D table gives customer R&D qualification as the TARGET (拟达到的目标) of both RDL resist projects; their stated progress is 'proceeding normally and in customer promotion' and 'plan tied to technology development topics' - the entry presented them as already in customer qualification.

items.label: T&S Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
items.signal_prefix: T&S Communications top five suppliers were 60.67% of 2025 purchases

set.signal: T&S Communications top five suppliers were 60.67% of 2025 purchases (RMB 501,354,676.66); the largest 39.94% (RMB 330,026,326.17), then 10.36%, 4.89%, 2.99% and 2.49%; names not disclosed; related-party purchases 0.00%. Raw materials were 74.47% of optical-communication cost of sales (2024: 78.17%) and direct labour 15.22% (2024: 12.10%), with the direct labour cost up 33.23% year on year.

items.reason: Clarity: 33.23% is the YoY change in the direct-labour AMOUNT, not in its 15.22% share of cost of sales (the share moved from 12.10%); the old wording read as if the share rose 33.23%.
